speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for coming in; I see you are experiencing fatigue, malaise, and unintentional weight loss. To help me understand the severity of your condition, how long have these symptoms been present?

speaker: Patient
text: 71-year-old male. The patient complains of fatigue and malaise over the last few months. He also reports an unintentional weight loss of 18.1 kg over the past 6 months. He does not recall any changes in diet or exercise routines that could explain the weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text: Those are significant "red flag" symptoms, especially given your age and the 18 kg weight loss. Have you noticed any night sweats, fevers, or swollen lymph nodes anywhere on your body?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and malaise. I also have Significant unintentional weight loss, No change in diet or exercise.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is a very concerning amount of weight loss. Beyond the systemic symptoms you mentioned, have you experienced any difficulty swallowing, chest pain, or changes in your bowel habits?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Has a history of diabetes mellitus type II, hypertension, non-seminomatous testicular cancer treated in the past, and hypercholesterolemia. Social history: Currently smokes 1 pack of cigarettes per day and drinks a glass of wine daily. Denies any illicit drug use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lung Cancer (Small Cell or Non-Small Cell)

Your history of smoking, prior testicular cancer, and significant weight loss are highly concerning for malignancy. Given your age and risk factors, we need to confirm this immediately.

REQUEST TEST: Chest CT with contrast
REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
